packages.name: better-compaction
packages.node: No upstream range declared. Loaded on Node 22.23.2 and 24.22.1.
packages.pi: No narrow peer range declared. Isolated tests used 1.5.2.
packages.config: Uses the active model and projected conversation.
packages.security: Evaluate only in a fresh project sandbox with local inference.
packages.tests: Recovered four markers and passed independent 32K coding acceptance in 181.60 s. Separate priming gave zero cache reads. An identical repeat reused 14771 summary tokens; native also processed four fresh tokens in the repeat. Fresh continuation prefill was still required.
packages.update: Review a pinned artifact and repeat the isolated tests.

native.codemode: Built in to Pi 1.5.2. Default direct tool set. Use only under the project sandbox.
native.compaction: enabled native: reserve 39322, keepRecent 20000 on 262144 coding-cyber-tiel-35b
mcp: Explicit --with-mcp: websearch, Context7 and read-only GitHub through the existing loopback services.

sandbox.tool: bubblewrap project launcher plus model-only HTTP relay
sandbox.scope: one explicit project; shared skills and runtime are read-only; agent state scoped to the project
sandbox.network: private namespace with a filtered coding-model relay; the existing MCP relay is opt-in
